description: Wizard101 Central is a community site and wiki focused on the Wizard101 game. Its public-facing programmatic surface appears to be the site's MediaWiki API for querying wiki content and related wiki actions.
summary: wizard101central.com exposes a public MediaWiki HTTP API at `https://wiki.wizard101central.com/wiki/api.php`; no GraphQL, MCP server, or CLI surfaces were found.
